blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Thursday said that it would place some of its police units under full alert status ahead of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit. The Philippines is preparing to host the regional high-stakes meeting from Nov. 15 to 17, where foreign leaders and delegations from the 11 member states and dialogue partners China, South Korea, Japan, United States, Australia, New Zealand, India and Canada will attend. The PNP said that the National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO), Police Regional Office 3 and Police Regional Office 4A, and its Crame-based units […]...
